commit_critical_path.definition: state load + fast dispatch + execution certificates + fresh OpenDSS + atomic commit
commit_critical_path.development_host_ge_300s_action: do not FAIL scientific experiment; record deadline overrun and mark realtime claim unverified on this host
commit_critical_path.qualification_hardware_ge_300s_action: realtime claim fails for that declared hardware; trajectory data may still be scientifically usable if all causal/safety gates pass

development_host_runtime_characterizatio.purpose: Measure the actual WSL workstation runtime without converting hardware slowness into scientific invalidity.

hard_failures: certificate or Fresh OpenDSS safety failure for a committed action

target_hardware_realtime_qualification.acceptance_rule: commit-critical runtime max < 300 s and deadline_miss_count = 0 on the declared qualification hardware
target_hardware_realtime_qualification.purpose: Support an explicit real-time/deployment claim on declared hardware.

slow_planner.reason: asynchronous background planner is outside the commit-critical path while a valid active plan remains in service
